sentences.text:
THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING,
THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 *Corrected vide court order dated:27.09.2023  -7-  NC: 2023:KHC:32411  WP No. 17164 of 2023  ORDER Learned AGA accepts notice for respondents No.1 and 2.

The short relief sought by the petitioners is seeking direction to the respondent authorities to dispose of the applications dated *27.12.2013 filed under Section 28(A)(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, as per Annexures A, B, C, D, E, F and G.
2.

entities.text:
Annexures A, B, C, D, E, F and G.
2
entities.label: PROVISION

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the said applications are filed pursuant to the order passed in LAC.No.108/2012 dated 21.11.2013, as they are entitled for re-determination of compensation in terms of Section 28(A)(1) of the Land Acquisition Act and the said applications are still not considered by the respondent authority.
3. Learned AGA fairly submits that, given same time, the applications filed by the petitioners would be disposed of in accordance with law.
*Corrected vide court order dated:27.09.2023 NC: 2023:KHC:32411 4.

Accepting the submissions, the following:
ORDER Writ petition is disposed of with a direction to respondent authority to consider the applications at Annexure A, B, C, D, E, F and G filed by the petitioners,
after affording sufficient opportunity, within an outer limit of 8(eight) weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.
All contentions are kept open.

Sd/-
